text: しぜんの　なかで　たべる　ごはんは　うまいぞ！

structure.jp: しぜんの　なかで　たべる　ごはんは
structure.en: a meal you eat out in nature

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: しぜんの　なかで　たべる　ごはん
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed right before a thing, describes that thing. しぜんの　なかで　たべる　ごはん = 'a meal that you eat out in nature'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, manly way of pushing your point. うまいぞ = 'it's tasty, I tell you!'
